description: Canonical PING Social prospect record. Canonical store: ~/workspace/your_files/western-co-prospects.jsonl (one JSON object per line). Retired: ~/workspace/your_files/western-co-business-owner-list.csv (backup at ~/workspace/goals/ping-social-outreach-campaign/hidden_files/csv-backup-2026-09-11.csv). Field semantics: ~/workspace/outreach/prospect-source-of-truth.md. known -> inferred -> unknown is a hard rule: empty string means unknown, never negative evidence, never guessed.

_migration_note.description: Set only on rows carried over from the retired CSV that do not validate cleanly against this schema. Names the non-conforming fields. The row is kept verbatim; nothing is silently coerced.

ai_discoverability.description: From observable evidence only. Never claim an unmeasured ranking.

booking_mechanism.description: As observed on their site, e.g. phone-only, online form. Empty means unknown.

conversion_state.description: Lifecycle outcome. Only a real reply, meeting, or customer event with linked evidence may set this; declines set suppression_state instead. Never invented by automation.

converted_at.description: YYYY-MM-DD of the conversion event. Empty means none.

conversion_evidence.description: Link to the evidence for the conversion event (e.g. responses.md section, file path). Empty means none.

email.description: Contact email genuinely published by the business. Never invented.

intel_updated.description: YYYY-MM-DD of last enrichment. Empty means never enriched.

last_signal.description: Newest meaningful signal, e.g. 2026-09-11 email SENT (round-29 batch).

missed_call_risk.description: Inferred from signals. Empty means unknown.

new_filing_signal.description: YYYY-MM-DD the business filed or opened. Empty means none observed.

next_eligible_action.description: Free text, e.g. F1 after 2026-09-15, watch, none.

notable_reviews.description: Short problem-category notes. Never reviewer names.

notes.description: One-line note: why they fit, stack signals, IG handle, caveats.

opportunity_confidence.description: Lowercase per spec. Legacy rows may carry case variants; flagged in _migration_note.

opportunity_evidence.description: Observed facts behind the opportunity call. Never invented.

opportunity_primary.description: The one primary opportunity. Pitch this only.

opportunity_secondary.description: Secondary opportunity. Mention only if it fits naturally.

owner_name.description: Owner name if genuinely published. Never invented.

phone.description: Phone genuinely published by the business.

priority_state.description: HOT: multiple fresh signals plus strong fit plus legitimate opportunity. WARM: good fit plus meaningful signal. WATCH: interesting but insufficient evidence. SUPPRESS: no, cooldown, contacted too recently, unsuitable. Empty means not yet classified.

region.description: "Western Colorado" for confirmed western-CO towns, "Colorado (town unverified)" when unconfirmed, wider values only per Nolan's expansion calls.

revamp_candidate.description: yes for old, less active, or non-technical businesses that could use a revamp. Blank means not yet assessed.

review_velocity.description: Free text, e.g. 3/mo, stale. Empty means unknown.

social_presence.description: Free text, e.g. ig+fb, fb only. Empty means unknown.

source.description: How the prospect entered the list, e.g. research, facebook, new-filing.

stack_signals.description: Short text graded CONFIRMED / STRONG INDICATION / WEAK INDICATION / UNKNOWN.

suppression_state.description: Canonical vocabulary only (see prospect-source-of-truth.md): empty, none, declined YYYY-MM-DD, bounced YYYY-MM-DD, cooldown until YYYY-MM-DD, ladder F1 YYYY-MM-DD / ladder F2 YYYY-MM-DD, queued-draft, opt-out YYYY-MM-DD, franchise YYYY-MM-DD. Never free prose; never the pre-2026-09-13 value in-follow-up-ladder.

website_quality.description: Inferred from public observation. Legacy rows may carry older variants (fair, good); those are flagged in _migration_note, not silently coerced.

title: PING Social prospect record
